title: Impact of Elite High School Admission on SAT Scores
research_question: Does gaining admission to an elite high school through a test score cutoff impact students' SAT scores? Specifically, what is the effect of narrowly meeting the admission score requirement on subsequent academic performance?
data_description: The dataset includes information on 500 students who took the admission test for an elite high school. Key columns are running_var (admission test score), treated (indicator for admission), and y (SAT score). The data focuses on students near the admission cutoff score.
